Towers arrive (spec §3.7, intro card §7.6): 2 towers 4 deep on a 4,3 board with 1 empty slot, 4 colors (the design TOWER16 families: orange, blue, red, green). Only the top nest of a tower moves, so the puzzle is which tower to dig first: the solution lifts green1 off the top-shelf tower. Not the design's 4,3,3 TOWER16 layout: with 2 towers that layout simulates easy (it is L18), and a hard L16 (§6.6 pattern, design A24) needs this 7-slot board.
2 towers 4 deep on a 4,4 board, 1 empty slot, 4 colors. The top-shelf tower holds the whole pink family; the solution starts by lifting [teal2, teal1] off the bottom-shelf tower.

The design's TOWER16 board (design/prototypes/NestyBoard.dc.html; tangerine, sky, cherry, leaf = orange, blue, red, green) with our hidden nests: [blue2, blue1] and red1 under blue3, orange1 under [green2, green1]. 2 towers, 2 empty slots. It simulates easy, so it is the easy level after the tower intro rather than L16.
2 towers (3 and 4 deep) on a 3,4 board, 1 empty slot, 4 colors. The bottom-shelf tower's top [purple4, purple3, purple2] has to step into the empty slot and back to swallow purple1.
Chapter 1 finale: 2 towers 4 deep on a 3,3 board with 1 empty slot, 4 colors, 6 hidden nests. Every lift out of a tower spends the only free slot, so the order of the digs decides the level.
Chapter 2 opener: 1 shallow tower (2 deep) hiding blue2, 3 colors, 2 empty slots on three shelves of 3.
2 towers (3 and 2 deep) on 3,4,3 shelves, 4 colors, 2 empty slots; [orange3, orange2], red2 and navy2 start hidden.

3 towers 3 deep on a 4,4 board, 4 colors, 1 empty slot. The solution starts by lifting yellow1 off the top-right tower.
3 towers 3 deep on 4,3,3 shelves, 5 colors, 1 empty slot.
